name: 800 Gondomar (Concerto)
description: 800 Gondomar, a garage rock band from Rio Tinto, performs a concert at Plano B. The band is known for energetic and disruptive performances.
longDescription:
800 Gondomar, a garage rock band from Rio Tinto, performs a concert at Plano B in Porto on Saturday, December 19, 2026. Doors open at 22:00, with the performance starting at 22:30.

The band is known for energetic and disruptive performances, mixing noisy chaos with a particular revivalism. They have a neo-realist creative and lyrical approach, exploring and subverting symbols of suburban routine in their music. Tickets for the event cost €8,49. This event is for ages 18 and over.

A banda é conhecida pelas suas atuações enérgicas e disruptivas, misturando o caos ruidoso com um particular revivalismo. Têm uma abordagem criativa e lírica neorrealista, explorando e subvertendo símbolos da rotina suburbana na sua música. Os bilhetes para o evento custam 8,49€. Este evento é para maiores de 18 anos.
